label: A small label above the title. Write “a · b · c” (with middle dots) for check chips. Stats: the line under the figure. Quotes: the person's line.
icon: A line icon above the title (see Icons for which means what). Image as icon puts the image in the icon's place. Leave None on photo cards.
image_contain: For a screenshot, report or drawing with text in it: shows the whole picture, never cropped. Keep it off for photos.
image_band: For a single card whose photo spans the whole row: makes the photo taller instead of a thin band. On phones the photo shows uncropped.
image_trim_top: Leave off. Only for an image file with a thin line baked into its top edge: cuts that line off.
image_focus_y: Where a cropped photo is cut: 0% keeps the top, 50% the middle, 100% the bottom.
link: Makes the whole card a link, unless the list has Link as a button turned on.
link_label: The link text. Blank uses the list's Default link label.
image_2: Images 2 to 12: extra photos stacked with the first one, or logos when Icon is set to Images as logo cells.
